page.overview:
Who is Thula?

2x03 "This Missive, This Machination!" (Debut)

2x03 "This Missive, This Machination!" (Debut)

Thula is a supporting antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 2 and onwards.

She is a relentless Viltrumite warrior of the Viltrum Empire, committed to its mission of universal domination. Following the destruction of Viltrum, Thula settled into Earth's human society to search for suitable mates to interbreed with and repopulate the Empire.
